# Shift Planner: results (generated by `python -m planner.evaluate`)

> **Synthetic users only.** Five archetypes simulated minute by minute and written out as the exact log events the app records (LOG_SCHEMA.md). Real users are messier; these numbers show the model is calibrated and useful on plausible rhythms, not that it is on yours.

Protocol: every simulated day at 18:00 the planner sees only the logs written so far and forecasts the next 96 slots (24 h); days 0-13 are warm-up (see the cold-start table). Tuning population 30 users and test population 30 users (6 per archetype each, disjoint seeds), 70 days each. Everything below is the test population.

## Chosen parameters (tuned on the tuning population only)

Half-life 56.0 days; shrinkage k0 = 2.0, k1 = 64.0, k2 = 256.0; slot kernel [0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 0.5, 0.25]; window: survival rule (maximize length x prod(p)^0.5, runs start and end on slots with p >= 0.8), at least 120 min, ending by the next alarm; auto-arm when every slot's lower bound (z = 1.0) is >= 0.6 after 7 nights. The population prior is the tuning population's mean P(idle) per slot.

## Windows, scored as the shifts they would produce

For each night the simulated user lays the phone down for the night at the first slot inside the window that starts 2 or more idle hours (an evening lull does not arm a Night Shift); the shift then runs until the window ends (**completed**, counts for the streak) or until the first busy slot (a pickup breaks it). **Dark hours** = the idle time the rig ran; **completed dark hours** counts only completed shifts. **Coverage** = dark hours over the next 24 h's longest idle block. **End error** = window end minus that block's end (positive: the window was still open when the user woke).

| Method | Window | Completed | Dark hours | Completed dark hours | Coverage | Median end error | Mean window |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| yesterday's idle block | 100.0% | 49.7% | 6.34 h | 3.38 h | 62.8% | 0 min | 8.9 h |
| population prior only | 100.0% | 87.8% | 3.41 h | 3.11 h | 37.2% | -105 min | 4.2 h |
| per-slot posterior, no day-of-week | 98.5% | 91.8% | 4.38 h | 4.02 h | 42.1% | -90 min | 5.0 h |

## Robustness: the app only watches 20:00-10:00

Slots outside 20:00-10:00 are unobserved, as if the app were alive only around shifts (scored on what the phone really did). Next-24 h Brier 0.1734, log loss 0.5078 (daytime falls back to the prior); completed 90.1%, 4.52 dark hours, 4.08 completed dark hours per night.
